title: Source Management
description: What sources do I have and how healthy are they?

panels.title: Source Overview
panels.description: All sources with their type, status, and opportunity counts

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name, s.domain, s.source_type, s.enabled, s.last_harvested_at, s.requests_per_second, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS opportunities FROM source s LEFT JOIN source_document sd ON sd.source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN field_assertion fa ON fa.source_document_id = sd.id AND fa.is_current LEFT JOIN opportunity o ON fa.opportunity_id = o.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.domain, s.source_type, s.enabled, s.last_harvested_at, s.requests_per_second ORDER BY s.name

panels.title: Source Freshness
panels.description: How recently each source was harvested — stale sources need attention

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name, s.last_harvested_at, now() - s.last_harvested_at AS age, CASE WHEN s.last_harvested_at IS NULL THEN 'NEVER' WHEN now() - s.last_harvested_at > interval '7 days' THEN 'STALE' WHEN now() - s.last_harvested_at > interval '2 days' THEN 'AGING' ELSE 'FRESH' END AS freshness FROM source s WHERE s.enabled ORDER BY s.last_harvested_at ASC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Consecutive Failures by Source
panels.description: Number of consecutive error fetches from the most recent fetches per source

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT s.name, f.outcome, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.source_id ORDER BY f.fetched_at DESC) AS rn FROM fetch f JOIN source s ON f.source_id = s.id WHERE s.enabled ), streaks AS ( SELECT name, CASE WHEN outcome IN ('error', 'blocked', 'rate_limited') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_failure, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 50 ) SELECT name, SUM(is_failure) FILTER (WHERE rn <= ( SELECT MIN(rn) FROM streaks s2 WHERE s2.name = streaks.name AND s2.is_failure = 0 ) - 1) AS consecutive_failures FROM streaks GROUP BY name HAVING SUM(is_failure) FILTER (WHERE rn <= COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(rn) FROM streaks s2 WHERE s2.name = streaks.name AND s2.is_failure = 0 ) - 1, 50)) > 0 ORDER BY consecutive_failures DESC
SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.name) s.name, ra.verdict, ra.fetched_at, ra.rationale FROM robots_assessment ra JOIN source s ON ra.source_id = s.id ORDER BY s.name, ra.fetched_at DESC
